title: Law 70 of 1993: land rights for Black communities
goal: Read and write the formal register of rules and notices, using the collective land rights of Law 70 as the topic.

items: I can turn an everyday request into a formal rule with *todo aquel que*, the future and *se*.
I can say what Law 70 of 1993 recognises for Black communities.
I can use the new words for territory, title and consultation.
